name_reason: Compliant with fd2_<domain>_<descriptor>. 'chapter_event_handler_34' encodes dispatch idx 0x34 in the per-event handler table @ 0x51B91 (table entry @ 0x51C61, verified via read_memory: bytes e2 52 03 00 = 0x352e2) -- 0x34 is a legitimate dispatch-index domain ID, not an address residue (the function lives at 0x352e2, not 0x34). '__ch23_ai_ctrl' accurately reflects chapter 23 (confirmed by fd2-knowledge ch23 events: reinforcements at upper-left/upper-right of enemy base) and the AI/cinematic-no-dialog category. No address residue anywhere.
purpose: Chapter-23 turn-event handler (dispatch idx 0x34): plays a 2-portrait white-flash cinematic pair at fixed tile positions, with portrait ids derived from the current battle turn counter.
logic_summary: Reads data_fd2_battle_turn_counter (@ 0x53BEF) as a byte and computes a portrait id in 8-bit AL arithmetic: id = (uint8)((turn - 0x0E) * 2). Calls fd2_cinematic_chapter_portrait_dump_with_white_flash twice -- first at tile (2, 0xB) with that id, then at tile (0x1A, 0xB) with id+1 (also 8-bit). The two ids form an even/odd pair; as the counter advances 0xE->0xF->0x10->0x11 the pairs rotate 0/1, 2/3, 4/5, 6/7. Does not read event_arg (1-arg cdecl dispatch ABI). Disassembly confirms: MOV AL,[0x53bef]; SUB AL,0xe; ADD AL,AL; MOVZX EAX,AL for the first id, plus INC AL for the second. The function body ends at 0x35316 and falls through (no JMP) into the CALL/ADD ESP,0xC/RET tail hosted in fd2_wrap_cinematic_chapter_portrait_dump_with_white_flash @ 0x35318 -- a binary size optimisation; the functionally-exact source is two complete calls.

params.reason: Generic but correct for an intentionally-unused dispatch-ABI arg; matches the convention used by all sibling handlers in chevt2.c. No address residue.
